status: research artifact only; no tracked files or providers changed

method.tableRequest: Eight target-snapshot hubs as sources, batches of up to ten legacy representative pins as destinations, annotations=duration,distance; no fallback_speed or coordinate estimate.
method.conversions: drive entries follow scripts/drive-times.mjs: [fastest-route km rounded to 0.1, minutes rounded to nearest minute], in exact hub order.
method.representativePinLimit: Legacy pin coordinates are representative area locations, not park entrances or trailheads.
method.walkEstimate: Straight-line distance from the OSRM snapped road point to the nearest edge of the full park polygon. Returns zero only if the point is inside filled land. Uses every outer and hole ring of every Polygon/MultiPolygon part. This is not a field-verified walking route, path, or access point.
method.unknownSentinel: For accessUnknown parks, importProposal uses drive=[null x 8] and walkM=0 only as the agreed composite unknown sentinel. The zero is not a measured walk distance, and the OSRM candidate remains in osrmCandidate for audit.
method.plausibilityGates: Mark unknown when official access is boat-only/no vehicle ferry, OSRM finds no route, the road snap is over 1 km from the complete park boundary, or the snap is on a different landmass.
method.ferryCaveat: The standard OSRM car profile can route over ferry ways. Sample route-detail responses show mode=ferry. Estimated route duration does not provide ferry timetables, operating hours, or waiting time.

noFerryProbe.result: Public demo rejected exclude=ferry with InvalidValue; no ferry-excluded matrix is available.
